{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check unique values in 'site' column to confirm number of sites
unique_sites = df['site'].unique()
print("Unique sites:", unique_sites)

# Check response rate per site
response_rate_by_site = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print("\nResponse rate by site:")
print(response_rate_by_site)

# Find site with highest response rate
highest_response_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
highest_response_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()

print(f"\nSite with highest response rate: {highest_response_site} ({highest_response_rate:.3f})")"}
